core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, interested in high-quality coffee machines that match his design aesthetic and lifestyle.
core_memory.user_preference_michael_espresso: Michael prefers a sleek, modern espresso machine with a stainless-steel finish, designed for a café-like experience without requiring professional barista skills. He values simplicity, aesthetics, and seamless integration into his home design.
core_memory.user_temperature_inquiry_michael: Michael is concerned about coffee temperature consistency and has had issues with drip machines that don't heat sufficiently, leading him to microwave his coffee. He wants to know if your espresso machines offer reliably hot coffee with adjustable temperature settings.
